faq.question: How do I know which chip works with my hotel locks?
faq.answer: Tell us your lock brand and model. We will check compatibility and send you a free test card kit. If you are not sure, send us a photo of the lock and your current card — we can usually identify the system.

faq.question: Can you supply both magnetic stripe and RFID cards?
faq.answer: Yes. We produce dual-interface cards with both magstripe (HiCo/LoCo) and RFID chips on the same card, ideal for properties transitioning from magnetic to RFID systems.

faq.question: What is the lead time for custom hotel key cards?
faq.answer: Standard production is 7-12 working days after artwork approval. Rush orders can be completed in 5 working days. Free samples ship in 3-5 days.
